description: This file contains generated Go code for gRPC service bindings based on Protocol Buffers definitions, including client and server interface definitions, method implementations, and service registration logic.

classes.name: grpc
classes.description: Implementation of a gRPC plugin for the Go protocol buffer compiler, responsible for generating gRPC service code.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the generator instance.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates gRPC service code for the provided file descriptor.

methods.name: generateService
methods.description: Generates client and server interface definitions, registration, and method handlers for a specific service.

methods.name: generateUnimplementedServer
methods.description: Creates a default unimplemented server struct for forward compatibility.

methods.name: generateServerMethodConcrete
methods.description: Provides default unimplemented method implementations for server interface.

methods.name: generateClientSignature
methods.description: Creates the client method signature for a given RPC method.

methods.name: generateClientMethod
methods.description: Generates the client-side implementation of an RPC method, handling unary and streaming calls.

methods.name: generateServerSignatureWithParamNames
methods.description: Creates server method signature with parameter names.

methods.name: generateServerSignature
methods.description: Creates server method signature without parameter names.

methods.name: generateServerMethod
methods.description: Generates server handler functions for RPC methods, including streaming and unary.
